comments: Information of tracklisting from Hal C F Astell's website.
Hosted by Ian Gillan from Stowe, Vermont, USA, where Deep Purple were recording their new album. From comments, this is presumably the second of two shows Gillan hosted while Tommy was on holiday.
Gillan live at the Reading Festival in 1980.

sessions.artist: Gillan: Recorded at the 1980 Reading Festival
sessions.details: Available on Gillan - Live At Reading (Raw Fruit).
